hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(\.config/mcp-ftp|ftp_config|mcp-ftp/[^/]*\.ini|\*\.ini)' || exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^\s*git\s+(commit|push|status|log|diff|fetch|pull)' && exit 0; printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Access to mcp-ftp credentials is blocked. Edit ~/.config/mcp-ftp/ftp_config.ini manually outside of Claude Code."}'
